nuggets.text: Blake Anderson was the Golden Eagles' offensive coordinator in 2025 before being promoted to head coach in December.
Blake Anderson played quarterback and receiver at Baylor before finishing his college career at Sam Houston State.
Blake Anderson's Group of 5 teams have beaten Kansas State, Oregon State and Washington State.
Kobi Albert intercepted three passes in the Golden Eagles' 49-3 opening win over Alcorn State.
In 1990 Brett Favre rallied the Golden Eagles from 12-0 down at halftime to beat Auburn 13-12 with 46 seconds left.
The Golden Eagles beat both Auburn and Alabama in 1990, the first non-conference school to do so in a year since World War I.
The Golden Eagles' stadium became Renasant Stadium this season, its first name change in nearly 50 years.
The Golden Eagles' mascot, Seymour d'Campus, is a pun on "see more of the campus," inspired by a 1984 World's Fair mascot.
The Golden Eagles were once called the Normalites, the Tigers and the Yellow Jackets.
The Golden Eagles' Eagle Walk begins two hours before home games with the firing of a cannon.
